title: The Average of Two Colours
summary: Two native colour pickers drive ten CSS color-mix() swatches that each compute a different 50% midpoint of the same two colours, so the average is undefined until you name a colour space.
mechanism: CSS color-mix() interpolation across ten named colour spaces (srgb, srgb-linear, lab, oklab, hsl, hwb, lch, oklch, incl. longer-hue arcs), driven live by two <input type=color> through custom properties; client-side only, no network.
references: Michel-Eugene Chevreul, De la loi du contraste simultane des couleurs (1839)
Goethe, Zur Farbenlehre (1810) vs Newton, Opticks (1704)
